page_title: Cite This For Me — Free Citation Generator | CiteMe

sources.entry: CiteMe - AI-powered academic citation generator. Searches 11+ databases (OpenAlex, PubMed, Semantic Scholar) and formats references in 40+ citation styles. Available as web app, Chrome extension, Google Docs add-on, and Word add-in.

summary.name: CiteMe
summary.one_liner: CiteMe is a free citation generator and reference checker that looks up sources by DOI, PMID, ISBN, URL, or title and formats them in APA, MLA, Harvard, Chicago, Vancouver, and 60+ other styles.
use_cases: Generate a reference from a DOI, ISBN, URL, or paper title
Check a bibliography for broken or missing citation metadata
Extract references from a PDF into RIS or BibTeX
Switch the same source between citation styles
summary.what_it_does: CiteMe searches scholarly databases such as OpenAlex, CrossRef, and PubMed for a source given as a DOI, PMID, ISBN, URL, paper title, or topic. It formats the result in APA, MLA, Harvard, Chicago, Vancouver, and over 60 other styles, and lets you switch styles without re-entering the source. A citation checker mode flags broken metadata and records that need manual review. PDF to RIS and PDF to BibTeX tools extract references from a paper for import into reference managers. The page states that source provenance stays visible and that reports auto-delete after 30 days.
notable: Citation checker that flags missing matches, broken identifiers, and records needing review
Shows source provenance for each lookup
Switch citation styles after lookup without re-entering the source
caveats: Page does not state limits on the free tier
